issues.t: Low-pressure fuel pump can fail and stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: The engine runs rough, hesitates, or stalls while driving, and may not restart. The check engine or master warning light may come on.
issues.why: The electric fuel pump inside the tank can stop working properly. Recalls 20V-012 and 20V-682 cover certain 2015 and 2018-2019 turbo NX models.
issues.next: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. If it is open, book the free pump replacement soon, since a stall in traffic is dangerous.

issues.t: Check engine light from a stuck fuel flow control valve
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on, sometimes with a slight drop in smoothness or power.
issues.why: The fuel flow control valve on the high-pressure fuel pump of the 2.0L turbo engine can stick, setting code P125D71. Lexus issued service bulletins with a repair.
issues.next: Have the codes read. If P125D71 shows up, ask a Lexus dealer about bulletin L-SB-0031-20.

issues.t: Hard starting or check engine light from low fuel pressure
issues.sym: The engine takes longer to start, or the check engine light comes on with lean or low fuel pressure codes such as P0087, P0171 or P0174.
issues.why: Low fuel pressure, often from a weak in-tank fuel pump or a fuel system part, makes the engine run lean. Lexus has bulletins for these codes.
issues.next: Get the codes read and check whether a fuel pump recall applies. A shop can test fuel pressure to find the weak part.

issues.t: Check engine light for turbo overboost
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on and the engine may go into a reduced-power mode during hard acceleration.
issues.why: The turbocharger makes more boost than the computer expects, setting code P0234. Lexus released a bulletin describing the fix.
issues.next: Have the code read and ask the dealer about bulletin L-SB-0092-16. Avoid hard acceleration until it is checked.

issues.t: Water pump coolant leak
issues.sym: Pink coolant drips or crusty pink residue near the front of the engine, a sweet smell, or the coolant level dropping.
issues.why: The water pump seal on the 2.0L turbo engine can start to seep or leak with age. Lexus put out updated inspection tips for water pump leaks.
issues.next: Keep the coolant topped up with Lexus pink coolant and have the pump checked. Replace it before the engine overheats.

issues.t: AWD rear coupling noise
issues.sym: A groaning, clunking or whirring noise from the rear on AWD models, often when turning or pulling away.
issues.why: The electric coupling at the front of the rear differential on AWD models can make noise or work incorrectly. Lexus issued a bulletin covering this.
issues.next: Have a dealer check the AWD system and ask about bulletin L-TT-0301-21.

issues.t: Vibration at idle in Park
issues.sym: A noticeable shake or vibration felt in the cabin while sitting in Park with the engine idling.
issues.why: Lexus found the 2.0L turbo engine can idle with more vibration than normal and released a repair procedure.
issues.next: Ask a dealer to check the car against bulletin L-SB-0119-17.

issues.t: Rocking or surging at steady highway speeds
issues.sym: A gentle rocking or surging feeling between about 30 and 70 mph when holding a steady throttle.
issues.why: Engine control on the 2.0L turbo can make small power changes at light throttle. Lexus issued a bulletin for it.
issues.next: Ask the dealer about bulletin L-SB-0153-17, which covers a software fix.

issues.t: Air bag sensors may fail (recall)
issues.sym: The air bag warning light may come on.
issues.why: Pressure or acceleration sensors for the air bags can fail, so front or side air bags might not deploy in a crash. Covered by recall 18V-085.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and have the sensors replaced for free.

issues.t: ABS actuator may not work properly (recall)
issues.sym: ABS, traction control or stability control warning lights.
issues.why: A part inside the ABS actuator on some early NX 200t models may have been damaged during assembly. Covered by recall 15V-341.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the dealer inspect and replace the actuator if needed.

issues.t: Air bag light on from center air bag sensor
issues.sym: The air bag (SRS) warning light comes on now and then.
issues.why: The center air bag sensor can set a B1000 fault code. Lexus issued a bulletin to repair it.
issues.next: Have the SRS codes read. Air bags may not work right while the light is on, so do not put it off.

issues.t: Power liftgate strut comes off its mount
issues.sym: The power rear hatch stops opening or closing smoothly, or you hear a pop when it moves.
issues.why: The power back door actuator can pop off its ball mount bracket. Lexus released a repair bulletin.
issues.next: Have the dealer check the hatch actuator mount (bulletin L-SB-0111-17). Do not force the hatch by hand.

issues.t: Doors may not unlock with the smart key
issues.sym: Touching the door handle or pressing the remote does not unlock the doors.
issues.why: Lexus found some vehicles may not unlock with Smart Entry or the remote and issued a bulletin with a fix.
issues.next: Use the mechanical key in the fob to get in, and ask the dealer about bulletin L-SB-0120-17.

issues.t: Rear brakes squeak after sitting overnight
issues.sym: A squeak from the rear brakes at low speed, mostly on the first few stops after the car has sat overnight.
issues.why: Surface rust and pad material can cause noise. Lexus issued a bulletin with a repair.
issues.next: This is usually not a safety concern. If it bothers you, ask the dealer about bulletin L-SB-0089-15.

issues.t: Slight pull or drift to the right
issues.sym: The car drifts to the right on a straight, level road when you let go of the wheel slightly.
issues.why: Alignment and tire factors can cause a pull. Lexus issued a bulletin on correcting it.
issues.next: Check tire pressures first, then have the alignment and tires checked.

issues.t: Dashboard cracks under the center vent
issues.sym: Cracks or peeling appear on the dashboard surface below the middle air vent.
issues.why: Owners report the dashboard surface around the center vent can crack and peel with age and heat.
issues.next: Use a sunshade to slow it down and ask a dealer whether any coverage applies.

issues.t: Musty smell from the vents
issues.sym: A musty or moldy smell when the A/C or fan runs, sometimes with water on the floor.
issues.why: The A/C drain tube can clog, even with insect nests, so water sits in the system. Lexus has bulletins on clearing it.
issues.next: Have the A/C drain checked and cleared and the cabin filter replaced.

issues.t: Hybrid battery cooling fan clogged with dust
issues.sym: A hybrid system warning, reduced fuel economy, or a hybrid battery that seems to wear out early.
issues.why: Dust and pet hair can build up in the hybrid battery cooling fan and its intake filter, so the battery runs hot. Lexus has a bulletin for 2006-2020 hybrids.
issues.next: Keep the intake vent near the rear seat clear, and have the fan and filter cleaned at service visits.

issues.t: Hybrid warning light in freezing weather
issues.sym: A hybrid system warning light comes on when starting in temperatures below freezing.
issues.why: Lexus found certain 2018-2024 hybrids can show this warning in the cold and issued a bulletin.
issues.next: Note the temperature when it happens and have the dealer check against bulletin LSB005523.

issues.t: Front shock mounts may be missing welds (recall)
issues.sym: Knocking from the front over bumps, or the ride and handling feel different at one front corner.
issues.why: Some spot welds where the front shocks mount to the body may be missing, so a shock could separate. Covered by recall 22V-238.
issues.next: Check your VIN now. If the recall is open, have the welds added before driving much.

issues.t: Electric parking brake may not engage (recall)
issues.sym: A parking brake warning shows and the parking brake will not apply.
issues.why: The brake control computer can wrongly detect a fault and go into a safe mode that keeps the parking brake from working. Covered by recall 22V-661.
issues.next: Always use Park and turn the wheels to the curb on hills until the free software update is done.

issues.t: Stability control may stay off after restart (recall)
issues.sym: The VSC OFF light stays on after you restart the car.
issues.why: If the driver switched stability control off, software may not turn it back on at the next start. Covered by recall 22V-239.
issues.next: Get the free software update. Until then, check that VSC is on after each start.

issues.t: DC-DC converter can short and overheat (recall)
issues.sym: Hybrid system warning messages and possible loss of drive power.
issues.why: A module in the plug-in hybrid DC-DC converter may have been damaged in production and can short-circuit, which raises fire risk. Covered by recall 23V-478.
issues.next: Get the converter replaced free. Until then, Lexus advised not charging below 41 degrees F.

issues.t: Steering wheel off-center when driving straight
issues.sym: The steering wheel sits crooked while the car goes straight.
issues.why: Lexus issued a bulletin for early second-generation NX models with an off-center wheel.
issues.next: Have the alignment and steering angle checked (bulletin L-TT-0318-22).

issues.t: Water on the floor from a loose A/C drain hose
issues.sym: Wet carpet in the front, or a greasy or oily smell from the vents.
issues.why: The A/C drain hose can be disconnected, so condensation drains into the cabin. Lexus issued bulletin L-SB-0031-23.
issues.next: Have the dealer reconnect the hose and dry the carpet before mold sets in.

issues.t: Check engine light after a cold start on the NX 250
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on after the car has sat in the cold and then started.
issues.why: The 2.5L engine computer can set codes after a cold soak. Lexus issued a bulletin with a fix.
issues.next: Have the codes read and ask the dealer about bulletin LSB000924.

issues.t: Apply-brake warning when shifting out of Park
issues.sym: A message tells you to apply the brakes when you shift out of Park, even when your foot is on the pedal.
issues.why: Lexus identified this message on some NX 250 and NX 350 models and issued a bulletin.
issues.next: If the brake pedal suddenly turns hard, press it much harder than normal. If it sinks, feels soft or goes closer to the floor, or a red brake warning comes on, slow down gently, use a lower gear, and pull over where it's safe. Don't drive on: call for a tow. Ask the dealer about bulletin L-SB-0051-23.

issues.t: Gauge cluster may not show some warnings (recall)
issues.sym: Warning lights such as oil pressure, coolant temperature or charging may not appear when they should.
issues.why: Software in the instrument cluster may fail to display some warnings. Covered by recall 26V-687.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: you may not see your speed or warning lights, so ease off, keep a safe distance, and pull over where it's safe. Restarting the car once parked may bring the display back; if it doesn't, have it fixed before you drive again. Check your VIN and get the free software update.

issues.t: Backup camera picture may not appear (recall)
issues.sym: The screen stays blank when you shift into reverse.
issues.why: Under certain conditions the backup camera image can fail to show. Covered by recall 26V-162 on non-hybrid models.
issues.next: Check your VIN and get the free software update or camera replacement. Use mirrors and look back until then.

issues.t: Camera view can freeze with Panoramic View Monitor (recall)
issues.sym: The rear camera image freezes or goes blank in reverse on models with the 360-degree camera.
issues.why: A parking-assist software error can freeze the picture. Covered by recall 25V-744.
issues.next: Check your VIN and get the free software update.

issues.t: Driver air bag may be disabled by steering cable (recall)
issues.sym: The air bag warning light comes on, and steering wheel buttons may stop working.
issues.why: A poorly welded joint inside the steering column spiral cable can separate and turn off the driver air bag. Covered by recalls 23V-480 and 25V-040.
issues.next: Check your VIN and get the spiral cable inspected or replaced free.

issues.t: Front head restraints can pull out without the release (recall)
issues.sym: The front headrests lift out without pressing the release button.
issues.why: The head restraint locks may not hold, so they would not stay in place in a crash. Covered by recall 24V-482.
issues.next: Have both front head restraints replaced free.

issues.t: Rear center seat belt webbing may be damaged (recall)
issues.sym: The middle rear seat belt looks frayed or cut.
issues.why: The webbing may have been damaged, so the belt may not hold in a crash. Covered by recall 25V-059.
issues.next: Do not seat anyone in the rear middle until the belt is inspected and replaced free.

issues.t: Front brake caliper and hub bolts may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: A clunk or vibration from a front wheel, or brake fluid leaking near a wheel.
issues.why: Bolts holding the front brake caliper and wheel hub may not be tight, which could damage a brake hose or let a wheel come off. Recall 24V-911 covers a small number of vehicles.
issues.next: Check your VIN. If affected, have the bolts inspected right away.
